country.name: Italy
country.regulator: Concorsi a premio must be notified to the Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (DPR 430/2001) and have a regolamento. Gambling is regulated by ADM (Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli).
country.eligibility: Usually residents of Italy (often also San Marino) aged 18+; check the regolamento.
tips: A genuine concorso names the società promotrice and publishes a regolamento.
You never pay to receive a prize or give card details to 'confirm' a win.
Many concorsi need a purchase (concorsi con acquisto) – keep your receipt (scontrino).
country.paid_note: Paid gambling in Italy needs an ADM licence
